name: chart
description: Column, bar, line, area, stacked column or bar, pie, donut, scatter, sparkline, radar or gauge chart drawn from its own data table: the table is the source of truth and prints, the inline SVG is a progressive enhancement from the opt-in faqir-chart plugin

changes.note: Nine more kinds on the same data-variant, drawn from the same table: area (lines over a fill that fades from each series' band, value axis from zero), stacked-column and stacked-bar (a segment per series, positives up and negatives down from zero, the total past each stack, series names on the first stack that holds them else a legend), pie and donut (a ring per series, a slice per row, shares on the slices where they fit, a legend beside or under the circle with each value and share; a single donut shows its total in the hole), scatter (x from the first value column, y from the second, a third sizes each point as a bubble by area; points named beside themselves where nothing collides), sparkline (no axes, a dot on the last value, height following width and a line's height in a table cell; once drawn its table leaves screen and paper, the aria-label reading every value), radar (a spoke per row, rings at the value ticks, a polygon per series dashed like lines) and gauge (a half ring per row from data-min to data-max, default 0 to 100; data-thresholds draws zones outside it and notches where each starts). Every SVG stays role="img" with an aria-label in the existing grammar — caption, kind, then every value — adding shares for pie and donut, totals for stacked kinds, and the range for gauges. New drawn parts: area, stop, totals, total, amount, share, title, track, zone, tick; shapes carry a hover title and the series under the pointer stays while the rest step back, purely presentationally (no transition under prefers-reduced-motion). A radar with fewer than three rows, or a scatter without two value columns that pair up, draws as a column chart. The table is now read from its own thead/tbody rows, so a chart inside another table's cell no longer reads that table's rows. column, bar and line draw exactly as before.

caption.description: The chart's title. It opens the SVG's aria-label, so name the measure and its unit here ("Revenue, thousand euro")

plot.description: Where faqir-chart draws the SVG; empty and collapsed until it does. The plugin creates it before the table when the markup leaves it out

data.description: The numbers: the last thead row names the category column and then one series per column; each tbody row is a category, its first cell the label, the rest one value per series. A cell's number is its data-value when present, else its text read in the page language; the text itself is what the labels and the aria-label read. Visible without JavaScript; once the chart draws, visually hidden on screen and printed under the chart

grid.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: the value-axis rules, one line per tick

axis.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: the tick and category labels

marks.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: one series group per table column, in table order

series.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: one series' marks, labels and name (for pie and donut, one category's slices across the rings). Its position in marks picks its lightness band

mark.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a bar, column or stacked segment (rect), a line's, radar's, scatter's or sparkline's point (circle), a slice (path) or a gauge's value arc (path). The new kinds' marks carry a <title> with their value, for a pointer

line.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a line, area or sparkline series' path, or a radar series' closed polygon, dashed per series (solid, dash, dot, dash-dot)

label.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a value label on a mark, the cell's own text, where it fits — a share on a slice, a value on a stacked segment, a name beside a scatter point

name.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a series name written on its marks (bar, column, stacked) or after its end (line, area) instead of a legend, where every name fits; under a donut's total or a gauge's reading, what it counts

baseline.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: the zero rule the bars and columns grow from

legend.description: Drawn by faqir-chart when the series names do not fit on the marks, and for radar, pie and donut (beside the circle where it fits, else under it)

key.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: one legend entry, a swatch and the series name

swatch.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a legend key's sample of the series' band (and dash, for lines)

area.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: an area series' fill (path) under its line, painted with the series' gradient

stop.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a stop of an area's gradient; its colour is the series' band from the stylesheet

totals.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: the group of totals — a stack's sum past its end, a donut's whole in its hole, a gauge's reading

amount.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a pie or donut legend key's value, the cell's own text

share.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a pie or donut legend key's share of the whole, as a percentage in the page language

title.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a scatter's axis name, its column's heading

track.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a gauge's full half ring, from data-min to data-max

zone.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a gauge's outer scale between two thresholds, darker towards the maximum

tick.description: Drawn by faqir-chart: a notch across a gauge's ring at a threshold

descriptions.column: Vertical columns from zero, one per series per row
descriptions.bar: Horizontal bars from zero, one per series per row
descriptions.line: A line per series across the rows, the value axis fitted to the data
descriptions.area: A line per series over a fill fading from its band; the value axis from zero
descriptions.stacked-column: One column per row, a segment per series, the total on top
descriptions.stacked-bar: One bar per row, a segment per series, the total at its end
descriptions.pie: A slice per row, sized by the first value column (a ring per further column); shares on the slices and in the legend
descriptions.donut: A pie with a hole; a single ring shows its total there
descriptions.scatter: A point per row: x from the first value column, y from the second, a third as the bubble's area
descriptions.sparkline: The series' shape only — no axes, a dot on the last value — for a stat or a table cell
descriptions.radar: A spoke per row, a closed polygon per series
descriptions.gauge: A half ring per row from data-min to data-max (0 to 100 by default), with optional data-thresholds

table.description: Where the data table shows once the chart has drawn: auto hides it on screen (a screen reader still reaches it) and prints it under the chart; visible keeps it on screen too; hidden leaves it off paper as well. Without the plugin the table always shows

value.description: On a td of the data table, not the root: the number the cell plots, when its text is not one the page language reads plainly ("about 40", or a figure in another locale). Without it the cell's text is read in the language of the nearest lang attribute, keeping its decimal mark and dropping grouping and units, so 1,240.5 in English and 1.240,5 in Romanian are both 1240.5. The text is still what the labels and the aria-label read

--chart-accent.description: The hue of the series ramp (custom property). The four lightness bands are mixed from it, the text colour and the background, so any hue keeps them apart in greyscale

min.description: Gauge: the value the ring starts at (default 0, or the smallest value when it is negative)

max.description: Gauge: the value that fills the ring (default 100 when every value is 0–100, else a round number above the largest)

thresholds.description: Gauge: comma-separated values between data-min and data-max where a zone of the outer scale starts and the ring is notched ("70, 90")

drawn.description: faqir-chart has drawn the SVG from the table; the table is visually hidden on screen unless data-table="visible". Absent, nothing is drawn and the table is the chart

methods.name: redraw
methods.description: Read the data table again and redraw the chart; false when it holds no number.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Stop watching the table, remove the drawing and show the table again.

required_attrs: a <table data-part="data"> with th scope="col" headers and th scope="row" category labels
the drawn svg carries role="img" and an aria-label reading the caption, the kind and every value
a11y.notes: The table is the accessible form: it stays in the accessibility tree after the chart draws (a sparkline's table leaves it, and paper, since a sparkline lives in a stat or a cell — its aria-label reads every value). The SVG is one image whose aria-label reads the numbers in table order: "Caption. Kind chart. Series: row value, …; …" for column, bar, line, area, radar and sparkline; stacked kinds add "; Total: row sum, …"; pie and donut give each value's share — "row value (34%)" — and a single ring's total; scatter reads each row's columns — "row: X 12, Y 86"; a gauge each row's value and then the range — "(0–100)". Its marks are not focusable; the hover titles and the hover emphasis are presentational. A chart's own data table caption names it when there is no figcaption.

safe_transforms: Change data-variant to any of column, bar, line, area, stacked-column, stacked-bar, pie, donut, scatter, sparkline, radar or gauge
Add, remove or reorder table rows (categories) and columns (series)
Edit a cell's text, or add a data-value with its number
Change data-table to auto, visible or hidden
Set data-min, data-max and data-thresholds on a gauge
Put a sparkline in a stat or a table cell, named by its data table's caption
unsafe_transforms: Draw the chart without the table (an SVG alone has no accessible numbers and nothing to print without JavaScript)
Give a scatter fewer than two value columns, or a radar fewer than three rows (both then draw as a column chart)
tests: the table is the chart without JavaScript
bar and column value axes start at zero
series names sit on the marks where they fit, else a legend
the svg is role=img with an aria-label that reads the numbers
the table is visually hidden on screen once drawn and printed under the chart
three series print in three distinct lightness bands
area fills from zero under each line, with a gradient from the series band
stacked segments stack from zero and carry their totals
pie and donut slices sum to a full turn, shares read in the label and legend
donut carries its total in the hole
scatter maps x, y and bubble area, names points without collisions
sparkline has no axes, a dot on the last value, and leaves its table out of print
radar draws a polygon per series on rings at the ticks
gauge fills from data-min to the value, zones and notches at data-thresholds
every kind's aria-label reads every value
